nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in constructor and checked by onlyOwner.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
DriveholicToken.symbol public string, set to DRVH in constructor.
DriveholicToken.name public string, set to 'Driveholic Token' in constructor.
DriveholicToken.decimals public uint8, set to 18 in constructor.
DriveholicToken._totalSupply public uint, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
DriveholicToken.balances mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances.
DriveholicToken.allowed mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as owner, token holder and allowance owner.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure, checked addition c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure, checked subtraction c = a - b with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure, checked multiplication c = a * b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure, division c = a / b with require(b > 0).
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner; stages newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() requiring msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner.
DriveholicToken() constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply and emits Transfer.
DriveholicToken.totalSupply() constant returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) debiting balances[msg.sender] and crediting balances[to] with safeSub/safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writing allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moving balances and decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) approving then invoking spender.receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner calling arbitrary ERC20 transfer.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data) external hook.
Unchecked-style arithmetic c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded only by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded only by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().
Arithmetic balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(...) inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with caller-supplied spender contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract, onlyOwner guarded.

edges.reason: Owned() constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
Constructor writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes caller-supplied newOwner into the pending-owner state variable.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership reads owner in the onlyOwner modifier guard.
acceptOwnership validates msg.sender against newOwner and clears it.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, transferring privileges.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, so caller identity gates ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], reading the untrusted caller address.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer performs the balance decrement through safeSub.
transfer performs the balance increment through safeAdd.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd for the credit.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub for the debit.
approve keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
transferFrom subtracts from balances[from] via safeSub.
transferFrom subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub.
transferFrom adds to balances[to] via safeAdd.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
approveAndCall keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the caller-supplied spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract under onlyOwner.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
